purpose: silver_airports cleans the OurAirports airports bronze extract (9057 rows, every airport carrying an IATA code) into a typed, deduplicated table of airport identifiers, names, locations, and codes for downstream geospatial and airline-reference consumers.
usage: Join on id (the unique, non-null airport identifier and declared grain) or iata_code (also unique and non-null in this extract); treat the text 'NA' in continent and iso_country as the valid North America / Namibia codes rather than missing data, and handle nulls deliberately in elevation_feet, municipality, icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, and keywords, all of which remain nullable after cleanup.
limitations: Cleanup did not impute or drop any null values: local_code (63.7% null), home_link (74.9% null), and keywords (68.0% null) remain largely empty, and icao_code (13.7% null) and wikipedia_link (13.1% null) are still moderately sparse, so consumers relying on these codes or links must handle absence explicitly. No exact duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0 across row_count 9057), so no dedupe logic was applied.
